name: Nothing To Wear Tee
note:
A sand-coloured oversized tee with a small burgundy front statement and a plain back. The neutral base makes it easy to repeat with black trousers, denim or shorts; the chest print adds a wry finishing detail.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
